description: Reliable Pi and Codex subagents, UTF-8 hooks, bounded polyrepo scans, and accurate platform detection.
changelog:
**Bug Fixes:**
- fix(pi): inherit the invoking session model in subagents and support max thinking
- fix(channel): surface Codex turn failures and enforce idle timeouts after completed turns
- fix(hooks): decode hook input as UTF-8 independently of the host locale
- fix(scripts): cap automatic polyrepo discovery and bound best-effort Git status probes
- fix(cli): detect configured platforms from Trellis-owned files
**Internal:**
- ci(python): compile every tracked Python file on Python 3.9 and run basedpyright
notes: Upgrade to 0.6.11, then run trellis update to refresh Pi and hook templates. No --migrate required.
